title: Attempts to Attack Singapore's Supply Chain Software
what_it_is: Attempts to Attack Singapore's Supply Chain Software

sections.label: No adverse effects observed
sections.summary: No adverse effects have been observed on CII and Government systems, and SingCERT has received no reports of Singaporean businesses falling victim.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: To date, we have not observed any adverse effects on our Critical Information Infrastructure or CII and Government systems.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: The Singapore Computer Emergency Response Team (SingCERT) has also not received reports of any Singaporean businesses falling victim to these attacks.

sections.label: CII Supply Chain and SG Cyber Safe
sections.summary: CSA will launch the CII Supply Chain Programme this year and is developing the SG Cyber Safe Programme to help businesses bolster cyber defences.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: CSA will launch the CII Supply Chain Programme later this year, in partnership with the owners of such infrastructure and their vendors to ensure that stakeholders adhere to international best practices and standards for supply chain risk management.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: At the same time, CSA is developing the SG Cyber Safe Programme to provide businesses with actionable cybersecurity tool-kits and resources to bolster their cyber defences.

sections.label: Government does not recommend ransom payment
sections.summary: The Government does not recommend paying ransoms to cyber criminals as there is no guarantee of restoring operations or data.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Second, the Government does not recommend the payment of ransoms to cyber criminals as there is no guarantee that the business will be able to restore their business operations or get their data back.

sections.label: Ransom payment encourages threat actors
sections.summary: Paying ransom encourages threat actors to continue their criminal activities, target more victims, and strike the paying organisation again.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The payment of ransom also encourages these threat actors to continue their criminal activities and target more victims.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Additionally, we also see that the threat actors will take notice that an organisation is willing to pay up and, therefore, consider that organisation to be a soft target and, therefore, strike again in future.

sections.label: Refer to SingCERT ransomware advisory
sections.summary: Businesses should refer to the advisory published on SingCERT's website for further guidance on responding to ransomware attacks.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: That is a very important consideration for businesses to take.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: We would also suggest that they refer to the advisory that is published on SingCERT's website for further guidance on responding to ransomware attacks.
